Advertising/Advertising_Domain.list:56560\n\n## Scope and limitations\n- Personal rules are audited but not rewritten or merged into upstream lists.\n- Exact duplicate rows are removed only within each individual file; cross-file semantic deduplication is not claimed. Identical rule-set groups are reported for review and are not automatically merged.\n- Source license notices are retained in SourceMetadata where available.\n- Manual review is still required for source relevance, financial exclusions, broad matches, and real Surge subscription behavior.\n
